seriesTitle: March Comes in Like a Lion

episodes.title: Rei Kiriyama / The Town Along the River
episodes.summary: Rei Kiriyama moves in to town, and his past is slowly revealed. Alongside battling opponents in shogi, he also wants to find that missing something.

episodes.title: Akari / Beyond the Bridge
episodes.summary: Who was that mysterious figure who stole his mail? And Akari's job is what?! Tune in as we continue to explore Rei's past.

episodes.title: Harunobu / Beyond the Night Sky
episodes.summary: Showdown between Rei and Harunobu in a shogi match! Will Harunobu finally defeat his lifelong rival? Tune in as we celebrate the end of Obon.

episodes.title: Hina / V.S.
episodes.summary: Will Hina be able to give her home made lunch to the person she is concerned about? Tune in as a fateful meeting unfolds in front of our eyes.

episodes.title: Agreement / Over the Cuckoo's Nest
episodes.summary: Rei must pick up Momo from kindergarten. Nothing can go wrong with doing this errand, right? Unfortunately, this leads Rei to remember more of his past.

episodes.title: Child of God (Part 1-3)
episodes.summary: Does Rei want to go somewhere, or just run away? Let's discover more of the Shogi world as Mr. Hayashida comes to the rescue!

episodes.title: Important Things, Important Matters / Teach Me How to Play Shogi
episodes.summary: What will Kiriyama and Takahashi talk about? Will it end well? Let's hope the cute kitties can teach us how to play shogi!

episodes.summary: On the trip back home from their commemorative match in Morioka, Rei and Souya are forced to stay in Sendai for a night because of a typhoon. Rei is relieved once they find lodging, but soon gets a phone call from Jinguuji, who tells him the secret of the genius "Shogi Demon," Souya. When Rei returns to Tokyo, he thinks over their match, while examining Souya's past game records. Meanwhile, Nikaidou is out of the hospital and is making a comeback with the first qualifying round of the King Tournament.

episodes.title: Burnt Fields (Part 1) / Burnt Fields (Part 2)
episodes.summary: Rei and Nikaidou are to be the board commentators for the final Kishou Championship match between Yanagihara and Shimada. All of the reporters and staff members that attend the pre-game reception turn out to be old friends of Yanagihara, who has been the reigning Kishou champion for years. Despite the immense pressure of an "away game" for the challenger, Shimada, he is determined more than ever to win his very first title.

episodes.title: Burnt Fields (Part 3) / Burnt Fields (Part 4)
episodes.summary: It's the final match of the Kishou Championship and the honorary title of "Eternal Kishou" is on the line for Yanagihara, the eldest active Class A player. As the shogi game approaches the final stage, Shimada is dominating. Yanagihara reflects on how he has been entrusted with countless metaphorical "relay sashes" from friends who had given up the professional shogi world before him. Despite the immense pressure, Yanagihara continues to play, as if he is making his way through the burning field.

episodes.title: Being Here / Summer Vacation (Part 1)
episodes.summary: Crescent Moon sets up a food stand at the March Town summer festival, featuring Akari and Hinata's new menu - "chilled rice dumplings with syrup." One of its variations uses the plum syrup made by Chiho, Hinata's friend who moved away after being bullied.Hinata had visited Chiho at the beginning of her summer break. Chiho was smiling again, but she was also still bearing the emotional scars. Hinata plans to share with her a photo of everyone enjoying the plum syrup, and also to visit her again.

episodes.title: Summer Vacation (Part 2) / New Year
episodes.summary: Hinata has been coming up with new ideas for sweets one after another all throughout summer vacation, but struggles to focus on her studies and deciding which high schools to apply to. Rei decides to invite the three Kawamoto sisters to some nagashi somen fun at his school. When Hinata meets the members of Noguchi's Shogi Science Club and Hayashida, she begins considering Komahashi High, Rei's high school.
